manifest.label: additional-box-centered-v1
manifest.policy: Existing generic single-box center/nearest-face calibration, constant pad-line roll, complete robot IK and3mm fixture clearance. Lift vertical approach raised60mm. Fixed contact005_velocity/.7rad_s/global4ms/1ms/servo.03 controls. No original source object, clock, geometry or physical gate changes.
manifest.selection: Four Lift sources with low original pad sections, and Stack demo3 whose centered face/roll sampled preflight passes. Existing original baseline plans only; all earlier failures retained.

report.object_check_scope: Original object reset is unchanged; all pregrasp samples checked for robot/object overlap
report.scope: Robot pregrasp TCP path and right-arm prefix only; original closure pose and closed suffix retained

actuator_audit.meaning: Control replay equivalence; task and contact success remain separate recorded gates

physics_report.object_state_assignment: reset only; actuator commands only during all physics steps

assumptions: Robot-only gravity compensation; object gravity remains enabled
Planar ideal base servos; wheels locked
Manufacturer collision meshes used as convex hulls
Finger gains kp=8 kv=.8 torque limit=2 Nm; arm kp=180 kv=24 limit=40 Nm
Unspecified robot/environment friction=1,.01,.001; source Can friction retained

left_head.calibration: URDF nominal extrinsics; no fitted lens/mount calibration asserted

right_head.calibration: URDF nominal extrinsics; no fitted lens/mount calibration asserted

torso.calibration: URDF nominal extrinsics; no fitted lens/mount calibration asserted

physics.object_state_assignment: initial XML pose only; dynamic free joint for every subsequent physics step
simulation_assumptions: Source-derived simulator properties are not measured real-object properties
MuJoCo version and robot servo settings may differ from source collection runtime
Object velocities start at zero at reset; only the recorded initial object poses are transplanted
Missing textures affect appearance only and are enumerated; collision meshes are mandatory
Global positive contact time constants capped at4ms; original damping, impedance, friction and all object state/geometry/inertia preserved. Distinct from source-fidelity validation.

simulation_profile.meaning: Alternative global virtual contact stiffness assumption; never promoted as a pass under original source contact parameters

physics.source_material_contact_policy: Original source physical fields are preserved as provenance; the explicitly named alternative simulation profile replaces only contact time constants in the executed model

plan.base_planning: explicit original-clock trajectory; saved in robot-initialization.npz
plan.closed_command_semantics: Original negative values are contact intent; actual motor target is recorded separately

grasp_attachment.policy: One constant right-multiplied robot TCP attachment on the complete original hand trajectory; object references, clock, geometry, gripper intent unchanged

shape_eligibility.eligibility: One unchanged source box collision geom in a free, nonarticulated object subtree

grasp_roll.scope: One constant robot TCP attachment; both calibrated pad-point world paths, complete source clock, object references, geometry and contact intent retained

interaction.derived_from: source gripper command, interpreted by the verified source adapter
interaction.limitation: one active rigid object and right gripper; other modes require explicit adapters

pad_alignment.gripper_policy: source commands unchanged; inferred aperture is calibration only
pad_alignment.pad_definition: area-weighted inward distal collision faces, proxy checked against source visual insert

previous_pad_alignment.gripper_policy: source commands unchanged; inferred aperture is calibration only
previous_pad_alignment.pad_definition: area-weighted inward distal collision faces, proxy checked against source visual insert

robot_control_retiming.method: local segment dilation with bounded reference speed and smoothed dilation envelope; linear joints, pose SLERP, zero-order held gripper intent
robot_control_retiming.note: Reference limits are planning constraints; actual physical speed remains independently gated

robot_fixture_clearance.aperture_scope: Five-point closed aperture envelopes and opening/closing transitions; continuous swept-volume clearance is not asserted
robot_fixture_clearance.fixture_pose_scope: Original compiled reset with source passive fixture initialization; no object trajectory or physics stepping
robot_fixture_clearance.scope: All compiled physical robot/fixture collision pairs; selected active-object subtrees and only explicit support pairs excluded

robot_grasp_approach.object_check_scope: Original object reset is unchanged; all pregrasp samples checked for robot/object overlap
robot_grasp_approach.scope: Robot pregrasp TCP path and right-arm prefix only; original closure pose and closed suffix retained

robot_initialization.gripper_admission_scope: Static sampled robot aperture envelopes; actual gripper tracking and all contacts remain independently physics-gated
robot_initialization.object_collision_scope: Source reset object stays unchanged; static admission checks environment and robot self only
robot_initialization.scope: Robot base and right-arm joint configuration only; no source or scene changes

shape_eligibility.eligibility: One unchanged source box collision geom in a free, nonarticulated object subtree

simulation_profile.meaning: Alternative global virtual contact stiffness assumption; never promoted as a pass under original source contact parameters

task_contract.frame: source world before rigid scene placement

plan.trajectory_seed: Original closed hand/object path with an admitted vertical pregrasp approach
